title: Standard Property Delegates
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of standard property delegates using at least one correct term from the lesson.

Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Standard Property Delegates** as part of **Advanced Properties and Class Modeling**. Classes group state and behavior; primary constructors and properties keep ordinary domain models concise, while initialization order still matters. Use the subtopics—Delegates.observable, Delegates.vetoable, Map-Backed Properties—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
